description: Issue summary: After a tenant-account split and API Gateway route migration for DataSprout AI, the customer reports sudden 429 responses for normal traffic patterns.
impact: Customer reports ~15% of requests returning 429s from the hosted API during peak ingest windows. Affects production traffic for several product endpoints; user-facing impact: failed document imports and generation timeouts.
environment_details: Prod cluster: us-east (pool-id: ded-us-east-2). Traffic was migrated to the new api-gateway route on 2026-03-04 23:40 UTC. Tenant was migrated to new account and a duplicate route was provisioned for blue/green cutover.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Use DataSprout API key (provided in ticket) to run concurrent batch uploads (~30 concurrent workers) against /v1/embeddings/stream and /v1/chat/response endpoints.
2) Observe per-request response codes at 1-3 minutes after starting high-concurrency workload.
3) Reproduce reliably only when both old and new gateway routes are active for the same tenant and both routes forward tokens through the edge-proxy rewrite path.
observed_behavior: Intermittent 429s with X-RateLimit-Reason: token_exhausted and short-lived bursts; many failed requests show identical X-Request-Id headers at the edge-proxy and two different x-forwarded-host values (old.example & new.example).
expected_behavior: No 429s for agreed quota during migration window; token accounting should attribute requests to a single tenant-bucket regardless of route rewrite during migration.
logs_and_headers:
Sample request trace (timestamp 2026-03-05T02:11:05Z):
- X-Request-Id: 7c1f9b8e-2a4d
- Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
- Host: new.api.datasprout.ai
- X-Original-Host: old.api.datasprout.ai
- X-Forwarded-For: 34.75.212.9
Rate-limiter decision: COUNT=1 -> BUCKET=tenant-12345-v2; Duplicate counter observed on aggregator from old route: BUCKET=tenant-12345 (legacy)
Response: 429 {"message":"quota exceeded", "reason":"token_exhausted"}
initial_hypothesis: Gateway route migration created two distinct accounting keys (legacy vs v2) and the edge-proxy produced overlapping forwarded metrics. The quota aggregator counted both streams because the migration path temporarily emitted both rewritten and original host headers; dedupe by token/request-id is missing in the aggregator write path.
investigation_notes:
- Traced request flow across api-gateway -> edge-proxy -> quota-aggregator -> rate-limiter.
- Found aggregator ingestion service (consumer group qagg-prod) received duplicate messages for the same request when X-Original-Host header was present.
- Aggregator keying used (tenant_id + normalized_path) but the gateway migration added a sibling normalized_path causing split accounting.
- Dashboard link: https://observability.redwood.ai/d/rl/tenant-12345/traffic?from=now-1h&to=now shows mirrored counts.
- Eng run a local replay of raw pubsub stream and confirmed double-counting for ~12% of requests during the migration window.
- Related PR that introduced rewrite behavior: https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge-proxy/pull/987
customer_communication:
2026-03-05 03:10 UTC - Initial triage update to customer: told them we saw migration during their window and actively investigating.
2026-03-05 05:45 UTC - Customer confirmed they rolled back partial client-side retry code as temporary mitigation.
2026-03-06 09:20 UTC - Informed customer of an immediate mitigation (gateway route rollback for tenant) and plan for permanent fix.
mitigation_steps_taken:
1) Temporarily rolled back new gateway route for DataSprout tenant at 2026-03-05T06:12 UTC, which reduced duplicate events and throttles immediately.
2) Added short-term aggregator filter rule to dedupe by X-Request-Id for 60s for affected tenants.
3) Increased tenant burst window by 25% for 48 hours to reduce customer-facing 429s while fix is deployed.
resolution_summary:
Root cause: duplicate accounting caused by gateway route migration + edge-proxy host rewrite producing two normalized keys that the quota-aggregator treated as separate buckets. Fixes: backported aggregator dedupe logic and patched rate-limiter keying to prefer 'tenant_id' primary key with host normalization. New aggregator release deployed 2026-03-09.
Post-deploy: 429 rate for DataSprout returned to baseline (<0.2% errors) by 2026-03-09 14:00 UTC.
follow_up_actions:
- INT task to add integration test for gateway migrations and aggregator dedupe: INT-81422.
- Update runbook: add explicit migration checklist (coordinate route cut timings, disable double-forwarding, confirm aggregator dedupe flag).
- Deploy permanent dedupe window config and expose as temporary migration toggle in Console.
- Billing check: validate that double-counted token usage was not billed; finance to review invoice window (ticket forwarded to billing).
related_billing_note: Preliminary check indicates duplicated accounting was limited to metrics layer; consumption billing pipeline (billing-prod) already dedupes by request-id, but finance will confirm. Billing ticket to be created if discrepancy found.
